game_concept: A puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep furs safe from frost imps.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep furs safe from frost imps. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the wall banner using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the wall banner is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ice Mill'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The wall banner reached with actions_used <= 22.
